statements.status_notes: PingFederate 13.1.3 and the current mainline ship jackson-core 2.21.1, which predates the completed fix for this advisory on the 2.21.x line (2.21.2 or later). The impact is limited to denial-of-service hardening: an oversized JSON document may bypass the configured document-length limit in some parser entry points, and exploiting it requires an attacker to deliver very large JSON bodies to an endpoint that parses them, with standard fronting-proxy body-size limits further constraining exposure. An updated jackson-core will be delivered in an upcoming release as part of the regular Jackson dependency refresh, which also addresses the related jackson-databind advisory CVE-2026-68497. As an interim mitigation, we recommend enforcing request-body size limits at any reverse proxy in front of PingFederate.
